title: GTA 6 PS5 update required before launch day, Sony says
description: The GTA 6 PS5 update is mandatory before launch, Sony says. Here is what Kotaku reports about the system patch, the day-one patch and launch timing.

body.text: The GTA 6 PS5 update is now a must-have. According to Kotaku, Sony has pushed out a required system software update for PS5 that players need before they can launch Grand Theft Auto VI. With the game's launch only hours away in the U.S., anyone playing on PlayStation should install it now rather than on launch night.
What Sony said about the GTA 6 PS5 update

The PlayStation Support account posted the notice at 8:25 p.m. ET on November 17, per Kotaku. It said the system update is required before playing the game and that players should download it before midnight on November 19, so they are ready on launch day.
Kotaku describes it as apparently a fairly big update. Sony has not said what it actually does, and the publication is clear that this is not yet known.
Why is the update needed? Nobody knows yet

Kotaku offers two guesses, and both are speculation, not confirmed fact. One is an extra layer of security to stop people from accidentally unlocking pre-loaded copies early. The other is a fix tied to the recent wave of jailbreaking and piracy on the platform.
Until Sony explains, treat both ideas as theories. What is confirmed is the requirement itself and the deadline.
GTA 6 day-one patch and launch timing

The system update is not the only download on the list. Kotaku reports that players also need a day-one patch for the game, version 01.002.001, which began rolling out earlier this week. It is 602MB, smaller than the 1GB update that went live on November 13.

items: Install the required PS5 system software update before midnight on November 19.
Download the 602MB day-one patch, version 01.002.001, if you have not already.
Note that the U.S. launch is at midnight on November 19, while the global launch is staggered.
Kotaku says the earliest time zones go live at 6:00 a.m. ET on November 18.

body.text: Kotaku also mentions that some players try to set up a New Zealand PSN account to play early. The outlet frames it as jumping through hoops and tempting fate, so it is a gamble, not a sure thing.

In a separate report that Kotaku links to, fans who bought a physical copy in advance claim their codes were already used or missing entirely. The report says the copies shipped with no disc inside. We have only the short teaser from the source, so details remain limited.

Keep an eye on PlayStation Support for any explanation of what the update changes. Also watch for launch-day server stability, since Kotaku notes that people online are already joking about an outage. If you are on PS5, get both downloads done early, check your local launch time, and avoid leaving everything to the last minute.

faqs.q: Do I need a system update to play GTA 6 on PS5?
faqs.a: Yes. According to Kotaku, quoting the PlayStation Support account, Sony Interactive issued a PS5 system software update that is required before playing Grand Theft Auto VI.

faqs.q: When should I download the GTA 6 PS5 update?
faqs.a: Sony says players should download it before midnight on November 19 so they are ready on launch day. Kotaku notes that the U.S. launch happens at midnight on November 19.

faqs.q: How big is the GTA 6 day-one patch?
faqs.a: Kotaku reports the day-one patch is version 01.002.001 and weighs 602MB. That is smaller than the 1GB update released on November 13.

sources.title: PS5 Gets Last-Minute Software Update That’s Required To Play GTA 6
